submissions.decision-capacity-constrained-rebate-ele: WITH candidates(election_ids, pallets_used, rebate_cents) AS (SELECT source_id, pallets, rebate_cents FROM offer_evidence UNION ALL SELECT a.source_id || ',' || b.source_id, a.pallets + b.pallets, a.rebate_cents + b.rebate_cents FROM offer_evidence AS a JOIN offer_evidence AS b ON a.source_id COLLATE BINARY < b.source_id AND a.supplier_code <> b.supplier_code) SELECT election_ids, pallets_used, rebate_cents FROM candidates WHERE pallets_used <= 10 ORDER BY rebate_cents DESC, pallets_used ASC, election_ids COLLATE BINARY ASC LIMIT 1
submissions.decision-capped-vendor-credit: SELECT o.order_id, MIN(o.order_cap_cents, COALESCE(SUM(MIN(i.affected_units * i.unit_credit_cents, i.item_cap_cents)), 0)) AS payable_cents FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN credit_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_cap_cents ORDER BY o.order_id ASC
submissions.decision-catalogue-freeze-correction-tra: SELECT f.edition_code, n.adoption_day, n.source_id FROM edition_freeze AS f JOIN editorial_notice AS n ON n.standard_code = f.standard_code AND n.issue_day <= f.freeze_day WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM editorial_notice AS c WHERE c.replaces_id = n.source_id AND c.issue_day <= f.freeze_day) ORDER BY f.edition_code ASC
submissions.decision-chance-adjusted-transcription-a: WITH counts AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(left_reading = right_reading) AS matches, SUM(left_reading = 'A') AS left_a, SUM(right_reading = 'A') AS right_a FROM transcriptions), agreement AS (SELECT n, matches, left_a * right_a + (n - left_a) * (n - right_a) AS chance_pairs FROM counts) SELECT CAST(ROUND(1000000.0 * (matches * n - chance_pairs) / (n * n - chance_pairs)) AS INTEGER) AS kappa_ppm FROM agreement
